summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares teclistamab with daratumumab and lenalidomide, and talquetamab with daratumumab and lenalidomide, against daratumumab, lenalidomide and dexamethasone. It is for people with newly diagnosed multiple myeloma who are not candidates for high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant as first treatment. Teclistamab, talquetamab and daratumumab are given as subcutaneous injections, lenalidomide is taken by mouth, and dexamethasone is given by mouth or intravenously; how long or how often is not stated. The record does not name a main outcome measure; its stated purpose is to compare efficacy.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 3 compara teclistamab con daratumumab y lenalidomida, y talquetamab con daratumumab y lenalidomida, frente a daratumumab, lenalidomida y dexametasona. Está dirigido a personas con mieloma múltiple recién diagnosticado que no son candidatas a quimioterapia de altas dosis con trasplante de células madre como tratamiento inicial. Teclistamab, talquetamab y daratumumab se administran como inyecciones subcutáneas, la lenalidomida se toma por vía oral y la dexametasona se administra por vía oral o intravenosa; la duración o frecuencia no se indica. El registro no menciona una medida de resultado principal; su objetivo declarado es comparar la eficacia.
who_for: Newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, per IMWG criteria
Not a candidate for high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplant due to older age, other health conditions, or a planned deferral
Agrees not to become pregnant, breastfeed, or father a child during the study and for a set period after the last dose
not_for: Prior therapy for multiple myeloma or smoldering myeloma, other than a short corticosteroid course within set limits
Myeloma Frailty Index of 2 or more (a score of 2 from age alone is allowed)
Stroke, transient ischemic attack, or seizure within 6 months before randomization
Known allergy or intolerance to teclistamab or talquetamab ingredients
Known contraindication to daratumumab or lenalidomide
